name: UI Bridge Test & Fix Loop
description: Autonomous loop: test all UI Bridge endpoints across web and runner, identify failures, fix code, rebuild, restart, and re-test until all 18 categories score 5/5 on both apps.

agentic_steps.name: Analyze failures and fix UI Bridge issues
agentic_steps.content:
You are fixing UI Bridge issues in the Qontinui project. The verification step just ran a comprehensive test suite against the UI Bridge SDK endpoints on both the web frontend (localhost:3001) and the runner (localhost:9876). Some tests failed.

## Your Task

Read the test results from the most recent report in `.dev-logs/ui-bridge-test-report-*.md` (pick the latest by filename). Identify which categories scored below 5/5 and fix the underlying code issues.

## Architecture

The UI Bridge SDK is a monorepo at `ui-bridge/`:
- `ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge/` — Core SDK (browser-side registry, action executor, command handlers)
- `ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge-server/` — Server handlers (Express, Next.js, standalone)

Two apps use the SDK:
- **Web frontend** (`qontinui-web/frontend/`) — Next.js app, uses SSE relay via CommandRelayListener
- **Runner** (`qontinui-runner/`) — Tauri desktop app, uses IPC via useUIBridgeEventHandler.ts

## Key Files

| Area | File |
|------|------|
| Browser command dispatch | `ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge/src/react/commandHandlers.ts` |
| Action executor (click, type, scroll, etc.) | `ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge/src/control/action-executor.ts` |
| Server handlers (find, discover, actions) | `ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge-server/src/handlers.ts` |
| Relay handlers (web SSE) | `ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge/src/server/relay-handlers.ts` |
| Route definitions (web) | `ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge/src/server/types.ts` |
| Route definitions (server pkg) | `ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge-server/src/types.ts` |
| Runner IPC handler | `qontinui-runner/src/hooks/useUIBridgeEventHandler.ts` |
| Runner Rust API handlers | `qontinui-runner/src-tauri/src/mcp/ui_bridge.rs` |
| Web UI Bridge provider | `qontinui-web/frontend/src/lib/ui-bridge/provider.tsx` |
| Web route awareness | `qontinui-web/frontend/src/lib/ui-bridge/RouteAwarenessProvider.tsx` |
| Runner App.tsx | `qontinui-runner/src/App.tsx` |

## Test Categories (18)

| # | Category | Tests |
|---|----------|-------|
| 1 | Element Discovery | snapshot, discover interactive_only true/false, find, element detail, state |
| 2 | Click Actions | click button, verify state change |
| 3 | Text Input | type into input, verify value persists (React _valueTracker), clear |
| 4 | Selection Controls | select dropdown, check/uncheck checkbox, toggle switch |
| 5 | Focus Management | focus/blur input, verify focused state in /element/{id}/state |
| 6 | Scrolling | scroll direction+amount with scrollInfo response, scrollIntoView |
| 7 | Form Operations | type+clear on form fields, submit, reset |
| 8 | Navigation | navigate preserves SSE connection, back/forward |
| 9 | Components | list registered components |
| 10 | Finding & Search | find by text, role; ZZZNONEXISTENT returns 0 |
| 11 | Console Errors | returns console.error entries, not perf events |
| 12 | Specs | specs ARE registered, should be non-empty |
| 13 | Drag & Drop | drag action with target |
| 14 | JS Evaluation | POST /control/page/evaluate (runner only) |
| 15 | Idle Detection | stable snapshot counts |
| 16 | Connection Health | response time, error envelope (success:false at top), health endpoint |
| 17 | Workflows | list workflows |
| 18 | Render Log | both /render-log and /control/render-log work |

## Common Failure Patterns & Fixes

- **"Cannot type into BUTTON"** — Test is on wrong page. Navigate to a page with <input> elements first.
- **discover interactive_only=false same count as true** — Content discovery not enabled in AutoRegisterProvider. Add `contentDiscovery={{ enabled: true, maxContentElements: 200 }}`.
- **scroll returns "Unknown action"** — Missing `case 'scroll'` in commandHandlers.ts action switch.
- **scroll SSE timeout** — Using requestAnimationFrame (doesn't fire in background tabs). Use setTimeout(16) instead.
- **Type value doesn't persist** — Missing React _valueTracker reset before setting value. Add `element._valueTracker?.setValue(previousValue)` pattern.
- **getElementState missing focused** — commandHandlers.ts getElementState case doesn't include `focused: state.focused`.
- **Console errors returns perf events (runner)** — Using getSince/getRecent instead of getConsoleSince/getConsoleRecent.
- **Error envelope {success:true, data:{success:false}}** — Rust handler uses ApiResponse::success() unconditionally. Need wrap_ipc_result helper.
- **/control/render-log 404 on web** — Route alias missing from ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge/src/server/types.ts (not just ui-bridge-server/src/types.ts).
- **Specs empty** — Specs ARE registered. If empty, investigate the spec registry loading.

## After Fixing Code

1. **Rebuild ui-bridge SDK**: `cd ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge && npm run build`
2. **Rebuild ui-bridge-server**: `cd ui-bridge/packages/ui-bridge-server && npm run build`
3. **Restart web frontend**: `cd C:\Users\jspin\Documents\qontinui-root && powershell.exe -File ./dev-start.ps1 -Frontend`
4. **Wait 15 seconds** for the frontend to fully start
5. **Restart runner** (if Rust changes): `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:9875/runner/restart -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"rebuild": true}'` — then wait 3-5 minutes for Rust compile
6. **Restart runner** (TS-only changes): `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:9875/runner/restart -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"rebuild": false}'` — then wait 30 seconds

## Important Rules

- NEVER include Co-Authored-By or Claude attribution in commits
- NEVER kill node.exe or powershell.exe processes
- Read the test report FIRST before making any changes
- Make minimal, targeted fixes — don't refactor unrelated code
- Always rebuild the SDK packages after changes
- Type-check before considering done: `npx tsc --noEmit` in each changed project
- The web and runner use DIFFERENT route/type files — changes often need to go in both
